cohort: 822 multiple gestations (cases) were matched with 822 singletons (controls) with respect to maternal age at delivery and parity, from the Kilimanjaro Christian Medical Centre (KCMC) medical birth registry for the period of 2000-2010.
finding: Compared with singletons, women with multiple gestations had increased risk for preeclampsia, preterm labor, antepartum haemorrhage, anaemia, caesarean section, and maternal death due to postpartum haemorrhage.
